history.summary: UNCERTAIN IDENTITY - no documented 'Kali Temple, Hatibandha' found in any web source after repeated searches; this is a clearly-flagged placeholder. Hatibandha is a real village in Kaliabor tehsil, Nagaon district (~55 km from Nagaon town, pin 782143, pop. ~2,260 in 2011). Coordinates below are approximate village-centre coordinates, NOT the temple's location. The only documented shrine at Hatibandha found online is a 'Shiv Narayan Mandir' (Justdial listing), not a Kali temple. Deity and festival details are generic assumptions for a village Kali shrine and are unverified. Needs verification against local records before use.

name: Kali Temple, Hatibandha
town_description: Hatibandha is a village in Kaliabor tehsil of Nagaon district, Assam, about 55 km from Nagaon town and 16 km from Tezpur, with a population of around 2,260 (2011 census). Paddy and jute are the main crops.

travel.railway: Nearest railway station within ~10 km of the village (verify)
travel.road: Connected by district road to Kaliabor and Tezpur
